sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 118

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 118:1
items.html: (To the question) The square of the letters of HaVaYaH and their fillings allude to the aspect of the Sefirot of the backs of that stature. For example, in the HaVaYaH of the stature of AB, whose nine Sefirot of the face were explained above in Answer 247: the back of the Keter of AB is the ten letters of the square of the four letters of the simple [name], as follows: Yud, Yud Hey, Yud Hey Vav, Yud Hey Vav Hey. And the back of the Hochma of AB is the square of the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, as follows: Yud, Yud Hey, Yud Hey Vav, Yud Hey Vav Hey — which are 26 letters. And the back of the Sefira of Bina of AB is the 156 letters of the square of the 28 letters of the filling of the filling, as follows: Yud, Yud Vav, Yud Vav Dalet, Yud Vav Dalet Hey, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav Yud, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav Yud Vav, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav Yud Vav Hey, Yud Vav Dalet Hey Yud Vav Yud Vav Hey Yud. And the back of the ZA of AB is equal to the back of the Hochma of AB, namely the 26 letters of the square of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin, as above. And the backs of the Malchuts of these nine Sefirot of the backs of AB are the number of each one, for the back of the Malchut of the Keter of AB is the Gematria of the ten letters of the square of the simple HaVaYaH, whose Gematria is 72. And the back of the Malchut of the Hochma of AB is the number of the 26 letters of the square of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Yudin. And the back of the Malchut of the Bina of AB is the number of the 156 letters of the square of the 28 letters of the filling of the filling. And the back of the Malchut of ZA is similar to the back of the Malchut of the Hochma of AB. And in this manner, as the nine Sefirot of the faces and the backs and their Malchuts in the stature of AB were explained, so it is in the HaVaYaH of SAG and the HaVaYaH of MA and the HaVaYaH of BON: Keter is the simple HaVaYaH in them, Hochma is the HaVaYaH in the filling, Bina is the filling of the filling, and ZA always resembles the Hochma of that stature. And likewise the nine Sefirot of the backs of every stature are always the aspect of the squares, in the manner explained in the stature of AB. And the aspect of the Malchuts of the nine Sefirot of the faces is the Gematria of the Havayot and their fillings in the straight [order]. And the aspect of the Malchuts of the nine Sefirot of the backs is the Gematria of the Havayot and their fillings in the square.
